t: 2nd fix circular saw blades are ideal for decorative wood cutting such as skirting boards, dado rails and architraves. Ultra-sharp teeth deliver a superior cut finish. For use with portable and stationary saws. Resin-filled expansion slots dampen noise and vibration. Reduced chipping and breakage.
b: Suitable for cutting Hardwood, Softwood, Plywood, Chipboard & MDF
